rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: POUlcrem, POUlrem
rows.Origin:
Bred by L. Pernille Olesen (Denmark, 2000). Bred by Mogens Nyegaard Olesen (Denmark, 2000).
Introduced in Denmark by Poulsen Roser A/S as 'Perfect Day'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Cants of Colchester Ltd. in 2000 as 'Perfect Day'.
rows.Bloom: Cream. Small bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, bushy, compact.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or container rose.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
